span.p:
SC-001 happy path, must
Given The PRD Forge Viewer PRD set has 18 documents. The root document and 4 sections are at draft, and 13 sections are at pending. Section 4 has a score of 61 and 0 blocking defects.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: When The author wants to send version 0.1.0 to the sponsor for early comments.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The author opens the PRD set and sees the product name, version 0.1.0, and the status of all 18 documents.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The author sees that section 4 has a score of 61, the lowest of the graded sections.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The author goes directly to section 4 and reads it.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The author fixes section 4 in the authoring tools. The viewer shows the new text and the new score without any action from the author.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The author exports the whole PRD set as one fixed-layout document with the Clay theme.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The author sends the file to the product sponsor.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The sponsor opens the file without the authoring tools and sees on the first page that version 0.1.0 is a draft.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: Then The sponsor has one fixed-layout document that shows version 0.1.0, the word "Draft", every section in order, and the status and score of each section.
